implementation_basis: Existing300/min continuous authored flutter electrode band
invariants: Continuous F remains present under QRS/T
One ventricular electrical/mechanical event per F cycle
P/PR builder placeholders do not move the80ms QRS event
Projection and monitorII parity; phase and wire recovery
limitations: Fixed established rhythm, no onset/termination or AV-node mechanism
Short repolarization support is authored, not textbook measurement
Physiology demo rejects1:1 until bounded perfusion integration; no calibrated hemodynamics
